name: DOOORS
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 18:00 on Thursday, April 6, 2017.

----------------------------------------------
The goal of this game is to escape from a locked room.
To escape, you may need some intuitive inspiration, such as touching the screen, pressing a button, or sometimes even tilting your Nintendo 3DS.
Escape from the room with your wits and inspiration!
